ground_truth.unit: change in the probability of correctly solving the decision task
ground_truth.location: Table 2, Panel (a) Choice quality, column 1, Intervention
ground_truth.context: Table 2 ("Behavior in the targeted choice domain"), Panel (a), column 1.  Lab experiment, subjects with scarce cognitive resources (the demanding background task of memorising a seven-digit number) in the Baseline, Directed Attention and Forced Choice environments, pooled over the decision-task payoff schemes and both experiment waves; the Ample-resources condition is not part of this table. OLS of an indicator equal to 1 if the subject correctly solves the decision task in a given round (one observation per subject and round of the main part) on Intervention, an indicator for being in Directed Attention or Forced Choice rather than Baseline.  No controls.  Robust standard errors clustered at the subject level.

i4r.notes: Meta-database row "table 2", o 0.107 (0.018) -> r 0.107 (0.018); DP43 Table 4 col 1.

recomputed.notes: Outside tolerance: reproduced=0.082992 vs claimed=0.107 (relative error 22.44%, tolerance 16.82%, the ±1·SE band with SE=0.018).

ground_truth.unit: change in the probability of correctly solving the decision task
ground_truth.location: Table 2, Panel (a) Choice quality, column 2, Intervention
ground_truth.context: Table 2, Panel (a), column 2: the column 1 regression (decision-task choice quality on the Intervention indicator, same subject-round sample) with controls: subjects' age, gender, field of study, high school GPA and last high-school math grade, ability in the background and the decision task (measured in the practice parts), perceived multitasking ability, and indicator variables for the subject's assigned payoff scheme and experiment wave.  Robust standard errors clustered at the subject level.

No controls.  Robust standard errors clustered at the subject level.

ground_truth.unit: change in the probability of choosing the default option
ground_truth.location: Table 2, Panel (b) Default adherence, column 7, Forced Choice
ground_truth.context: Table 2, Panel (b), column 7: the Forced Choice coefficient of the same regression (default adherence on Directed Attention and Forced Choice indicators, Baseline omitted, no controls, robust standard errors clustered by subject).  In Forced Choice the decision task has no preselected option, so "default adherence" means choosing the alternative that is the default in the other environments.

No controls; robust standard errors clustered at the subject level.  Not statistically significant.
